"content": "Usage: mcpjam cloud eval [options] [command]

Author and run eval suites in your hosted MCPJam projects

Options:\

n -h, --help display help for command

Commands:
 create [options] Create a runnable eval suite fro
m authored test\n cases (does not run it)\n list [options] List the eval suites saved in
a project\n runs [options] List a suite's run history, newest first\n revisions [options] List a suite's sett
ings history, newest first\n run [options] Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a\n
versioned suite file and run it. The\n upload-and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not\n
per request (raise it with the global --timeout\n <ms>); --wait-timeout bou
nds the RUN instead.\n status [options] Get the status and summary of an eval run\n stage-analytics [options] Read th
e user-value chain funnel for one run\n (--run) or a suite's runs as a trend series\n
(--suite)\n route-facts [options] Read the tool routes a run's trials took — which\n
paths were used, and which expected tools were\n missing or substituted\n server-facts [options]
Read the server a run was taken against — tool\n surface, catalog size, annotation coverage,\n
tool-metadata signals, and what connect and\n discovery observed\n description-

experiment Propose, start, or read a two-arm tool-description
Usage: mcpjam cloud eval create [options]

Create a runnable

eval suite from authored test cases (does not run it)

Options:
 --project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the
most recently\n updated project)\n --file <path> Path to a create-API JSON body (or - for
stdin). A\n versioned suite file belongs on `eval run --file`\n --json <json> Inline suit
e definition JSON (or @file, or - for\n stdin)\n --name <name> Suite name (overrides the f
ile)\n --model <model> Suite-level default model (overrides the file)\n --provider <provider> Suite-level default
provider (overrides the file;\n needed for bare/custom model ids)\n --server <id-or-name...> Project
HTTP server names or IDs (overrides the\n file)\n --client <id-or-name...> Clients to attach the suit
e to, by name or ID\n (overrides the file). Without one the suite lists no\n
client and `eval run --client` has nothing to select\n --host <id-or-name...> Deprecated alias for --client\n -h, --help

display help for command
Usage: mcpjam cloud projects [options] [command]

Operate the MCP servers saved in your ho

sted MCPJam projects

Options:
 -h, --help display help for command

Commands:
 list [options] List
the projects you can access\n create [options] Create a hosted MCPJam project\n update [options] Update project me
tadata\n delete [options] Delete a project and its project-owned resources\n capabilities [options] Show what you may do
in a project: your role, which\n betas the organization has, your plan's limits, and a\n
can-block of booleans. Ask this before scripting\n anything that authors, launches or publishes
.\n servers [options] List and manage the servers saved in a project\n status [options] Health-check every server i
n a project (hosted doctor\n per server)\n help [command] display help for command", "is_error"
